title: External Entropy
description: External entropy lets a person contribute independent randomness to wallet seed generation instead of relying only on a device's internal generator. Dice, cards, coins, and other physical methods can work when their outcomes are unbiased, kept secret, counted correctly, and converted into key material without mistakes.

resources.title: COLDCARD: Verifying Dice Roll Math
resources.notes: Explains how dice outcomes become seed entropy and why the number and privacy of rolls matter.

resources.title: BIP 39: Mnemonic Code
resources.notes: Defines how initial entropy is checksummed and encoded as a mnemonic phrase.

resources.title: NIST SP 800-90B: Entropy Sources
resources.notes: Provides the broader model for entropy sources, conditioning, and health considerations.
